fact: Niger's Director General of Customs announced on 30 March 2026 that electronic payment of customs duties and taxes at SONIBANK (counters, payment terminals, ATMs, later e-money) resumes on 1 April 2026, after being suspended since July 2023; order-of-payment declarations are excluded.
title: Point de presse à la Direction Générale des Douanes : Les opérations de paiement électronique en Banque des droits et taxes liquidés en douanes reprennent le 1er Avril 2026
